questions.question: How satisfied were you with the resolution of your issue?
questions.explanation: Considers whether the outcome fully addressed the problem you reported.

questions.question: How would you rate the communication you received while the issue was open?
questions.explanation: Covers how clearly and how often we kept you updated.

questions.question: Was the issue resolved within an acceptable timeframe?
questions.explanation: Judged against the urgency you expected, not our internal targets.

questions.question: Which part of the resolution worked best for you?
questions.explanation: Select the single area that stood out.

questions.question: What could we have done better?
questions.explanation: Free text. Anything you share is reviewed by the account team.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied are you with our service this quarter?
questions.explanation: Your general impression across everything we delivered in the period.

questions.question: How likely are you to recommend us to a colleague?
questions.explanation: 0 means not at all likely, 10 means extremely likely.

questions.question: Any comments you would like to share with the account team?
